title: Sword Agent OS Thought Core Topology

nodes.label: ai-talk-core
nodes.summary: Owns browser microphone recording, STT, transcript, and handoff files.

nodes.label: Thought Core API
nodes.summary: Owns turn-level reasoning, state checks, tool routing, action requests, and response events.

nodes.label: Thought Core watcher
nodes.summary: Watches ai-talk-core handoff output, sends turns to Thought Core, and forwards response events.

nodes.label: Environment State Server
nodes.summary: Projects environment snapshots and display-safe indicators from source modules.

nodes.label: Home Assistant bridge
nodes.summary: Owns action allowlists, preview, execute, and Home Assistant result interpretation.

nodes.label: TTS service
nodes.summary: Synthesizes and plays response speech from Thought Core watcher chunks.

nodes.label: AITuber Kit Projection Visual
nodes.summary: Owns browser-facing avatar speech queue, projection UI, and HUD surfaces.

nodes.label: Integration console
nodes.summary: Displays local status projections and does not own business state.
